suggested_change: CLAUDE.md should add: (1) When prior transcript is corrupted/unusable, carry forward prior score with explicit notation rather than regressing; (2) Next steps must use format '[Contact Name]: Action verb + specific question + date' not generic discovery lists; (3) Distinguish 'no evidence found' (appropriate for early deals, neutral tone) from 'contradictory evidence' (red flag language only when calls explicitly contradict prior claims); (4) Remove speculative footnotes unsupported by call content—flag unknowns as open questions instead.
